{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Does All-Wise Popara do a lot of trade in spice?''"<br />"''Some. Mostly medicinal. This is not the first time Great Popara has directed spice to handle a crisis.|Reen Irana and Vago, on Popara's involvement in the spice trade|<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
'''Medicinal spice''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] narcotic variant with healing properties. During the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|New Republic era]], [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]], head of the [[Anjiliac]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]], traded in medicinal spice. In  [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Popara donated a shipment of medicinal space to help combat a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly plague]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]].
 
==Description==
{{Quote|We don't know the specific details of the plague itself, so the spice is a broadband antisporant and pain suppressor.|Vago, on the medicinal spice provided by Popara for distribution on Endregaad|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
Medicinal spice was a type of the narcotic [[Spice/Legends|spice]] possessing healing properties. It could be administered via a hypodermic needle. Unlike raw [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] spice from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], medicinal spice did not immediately deteriorate in sunlight, though exposure to sunlight did lessen its potency.<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>
 
A variant of spice transported to the planet [[Endregaad]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] had pain suppressant and antisporant properties.<ref name="Scourge" /> When mixed with the healing substance [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], this medicinal spice variant produced a treatment against the [[Endregaad Plague]], a deadly disease that originated on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. Administration of a shot of this variant to an individual afflicted with the plague would either cure them or provide a vaccine rendering them immune to the disease for thirty [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
==History==
[[File:Popara.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Popara, a Hutt who traded in medicinal spice]]
During the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|New Republic era]], the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]],<ref name="Scourge" /> the governing authority of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]],<ref name="CSWE CSA">{{CSWECite|I|145|Corporate Sector Authority (CSA)}}</ref> held stores of medicinal spice on the<ref name="Scourge" /> planet<ref name="CSWE Duroon">{{CSWECite|I|218|Duroon}}</ref> [[Duroon]]. [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]], leader of the Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] [[Anjiliac]], traded in medicinal spice and occasion donated it for humanitarian crises.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
In 19 ABY,<ref name="Scourge" /> following the outbreak on the planet Endregaad of the Endregaad Plague, the world was placed under [[Quarantine of Endregaad|quarantine]] by the Corporate Sector Authority and [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Angela Krin]], the official overseeing the quarantine, contacted the CSA [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] on Duroon to request medicinal spice for treatment of the contagion but was informed that no approval was in place to distribute the spice and furthermore, insufficient stocks were available for a planet-wide crisis.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
Separately, Popara donated supplies of<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> high grade<ref name="Scourge" /> medicinal spice for distribution on Endregaad to ease the crisis <ref name="Tempest Feud" /> and arranged for the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] to deliver the spice to the plague-stricken world.<ref name="Scourge" /> Popara's son [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika]] was missing on Endregaad and Popara believed that supplying the medicinal spice would provide <ref name="Tempest Feud" /> Zuma, Irana and Be'ray<ref name="Scourge" /> a means to negotiate access through the CSA blockade; the actual delivery of the spice was entirely a secondary objective to finding Mika.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> Uncertain of the nature of the contagion on Endregaad, Vago procured medicinal spice with pain suppressant and antisporant attributes.<ref name="Scourge" /> Popara's aides informed the CSA of the impending delivery and his intermediary Vago facilitated the loading of the spice aboard [[Suwantek Systems|Suwantek]] [[TL-1200 transport]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> ''[[New Ambition]]'' at a [[Landing pad X-13|landing pad]] in [[Makem Te spaceport]] on the planet [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]].<ref name="Scourge" /> In addition to the main cargo, Vago also provided the Popara's delivery agents a pouch with ten extra packets of medicinal spice for use in negotiations with the Endregaad locals. Vago further instructed that two of the packets be kept aside for Mika, in case the Anjiliac scion had succumbed to the Endregaad Plague.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
Eager to thwart Mika's rescue, Popara's eldest son [[Zonnos Anjiliac Priare|Zonnos]] concealed four [[crab tracer]] [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking devices]] among the medicinal spice cargo aboard the Suwantek [[Transport/Legends|transport]], concealed in the frames of the spice cases. The tracers transmitted the location of the vessel to the [[Bomu Clan]]&mdash;[[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired by Zonnos&mdash;and the Bomu Clan [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Vengeance (YV-260 light freighter)|''Vengeance'']] ambushed the Suwantek transport as it approached Endregaad, demanding that it jettison its spice cargo.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> However, the Bomu vessel was destroyed by CSA [[IRD starfighter]]s enforcing the Corporate Sector blockade.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
[[File:Angela_Krin.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lieutenant Commander Angela Krin of the Corporate Sector Authority]]
After the attack, ''New Ambition'', with the [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']], the lead Corporate Sector vessel directing the quarantine. Mander Zuma donated the medicinal spice cargo to Angela Krin for distribution on Endregaad before it could be seized. Although Krin lacked authorization to distribute the spice, her team began examining its properties. The unapproved delivery alarmed CSA officials, who were embarrassed that an independent supply had arrived first—prompting them to immediately divert their own stock of medicinal spice to the planet.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
The CSA subsequently dispersed medicinal spice on Endregaad to alleviate the plague.<ref name="Scourge" /> A [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] caravan led by the trader [[Simol Toc]] acquired a portion of the spice in an illicit deal with a CSA [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. The group departed from Endregaad's main [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]] carrying their spice in [[cargo lifter]]s hauled by a [[chando]] beast, bound for the plague-stricken settlement. [[Temple Valley]]. En-route, armed guards were posted around the spice overnight and upon their arrival at Temple Valley, the medicinal spice was distributed to the struggling local population.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Medicinal spice first appeared in ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure, by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] that was a supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> It later appeared in [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], a [[2012]] novelization by Jeff Grubb of ''Tempest Feud''<ref name="Scourge" /> and was also mentioned in the 2012 reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
 
===''Tempest Feud'' roleplay outcomes===
''Tempest Feud'' is designed to be set in any roleplaying era at the discretion of the gamemaster, with potential settings ranging from the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> ''Scourge'' established the official setting of the delivery of the medicinal spice to Endregaad to be the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
In ''Tempest Feud'', the players roleplay as individuals hired by Popara to deliver medicinal spice to Endregaad,<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> a role fulfiled by by Mander Zuma, Reen Irana and Eddey Be'ray in ''Scourge''.<ref name="Scourge" /> If the player characters abscond with the spice and do not deliver it to Endregaad they can receive {{Cr}}100,000 for the selling the cargo to a buyer, though the individual that they sell the spice to is [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Bomu Clan [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Narnee Bomu]] and [[Seedar Bomu]], who are sent by Vago to recover the stolen spice.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
When the Suwantek transport is ambushed near Endregaad by the Bomu Clan, the players may choose to jettison the medicinal spice, allowing the Bomu to escape with it. If they do, Popara does not reprimand them&mdash;provided they rescue Mika on Endregaad. Alternatively, the players might defeat the Bomu or lose the spice to a boarding party led by Bomu [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Ormann Bomu|Ormann]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> In ''Scourge'', however, the spice is successfully delivered to the CSA and not seized by the attackers.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
Upon arriving aboard the ''Resolute'', Mander Zuma hands over the spice to Angela Krin in ''Scourge''.<ref name="Scourge" /> In ''Tempest Feud'', however, the players can negotiate with Krin for access to Endregaad and may choose not to surrender the spice, instead running the CSA blockade to deliver it themselves. Once on Endregaad, it is possible that the players use a doses of medicinal spice to treat Mika's [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] aide [[Orgamon]] and later the [[Geode (rock)|geode]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] [[Huwin Clathor]], both of whom contracted the Endregaad plague. If the players succeeded at delivering medicinal spice to Endregaad, some of the spice is transported by Simol Toc's caravan to Temple Valley.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> This article assumes that to be the official outcome since in ''Scourge'', Zuma, Irana and Be'ray do successfully handover the spice to the CSA forces on Endregaad.<ref name="Scourge" />
